lrw.text: Maralen seems to be a Mornsong elf travelling with Rhys, but she is really a fae duplicate bearing a piece of Oona's soul, created after Oona killed the real Maralen and replaced her body with a faerie vessel.
The new Maralen gains sentience, turns against her creator and joins others to investigate Oona.
After the Great Aurora turns the plane into Shadowmoor, a coalition including Maralen and Rhys defeats Oona, and Maralen becomes queen of the fae and binds Rhys to her, granting him immortality.

mor.text: In Morningtide, Maralen sends the Vendilion clique on the gravest of tasks.
The clique tries to read the party's thoughts but cannot breach Maralen's mind, so it whisks her away to Glen Elendra as a gift to Oona.

There it learns that Maralen is a faerie duplicate and begins to obey her, and she makes Gryffid and the rangers vanish in fog while Endry's mushroom ring lets her divert energy from Ashling's ritual.

shm.text: In Shadowmoor, Oona kills the elf Maralen and replaces her with her half-formed daughter, who gains unintended sentience and returns to her companions unaware she travels with Oona's spies.
Conflict grows between Maralen and Oona, and Maralen, Brigid Baeli and Sygg thwart Oona's attempt to take Ashling's elemental power, though Maralen betrays Sygg and keeps the Crescent.

Maralen's rebels and Oona's loyalists clash in the last great battle of the fae, Maralen and Oona fight in single combat above Cayr Ulios, and Oona is defeated at Glen Elendra with the sacrifice of the Sapling of Colfenor.
Maralen becomes queen of the fae as day returns.

eve.text: In Eventide, Maralen steals Ashling's power with the scroll and Crescent, and with moonglove she deals Oona the killing blow, becoming queen of the fae.
She gives Rhys a moonglove flower to use on her if Oona ever returns through her, and he becomes unable to die until he can fulfill his oath.
Later Oko manipulates Rhys into believing Maralen is becoming Oona, and Rhys strikes her with moonglove as their pact demanded.
Oko admits he orchestrated the ordeal and cures his sister with dawnglow, and Rhys declines a new oath, bids Maralen farewell and fades into a shower of petals.

ecl.text: Maralen began as a duplicate that Oona created from a Mornsong elf and gave a piece of her soul, and after Oona was defeated she took the mantle of queen of the fae and bound herself to Rhys with a death pact.
When Maralen finds petals of Oona's flesh in her chamber she fears her independence is unraveling, and she tells Tam and Sanar that Oona is returning and she does not know if she can stop her.

Rhys bursts in to keep his promise, so Maralen explains the death pact and flees with her new companions, and later she tells Ashling that she was made as Oona's avatar and that eternal day is Oona's way, not her own.
Rhys cuts her with a poisoned dagger and she bleeds petals, but her brother Oko, whom she recognizes in the small green faerie, declares Oona dead and revives her with dawnglow.
Maralen forgives Rhys, who then dissolves into flower petals, and she offers Oko a home in Glen Elendra as steward of the plane alongside Eirdu and Isilu.
